purpose.target_triangles: One automatically simplified runtime mesh; the dense source is retained.
purpose.source_fps: Bake rate of the source animation; independent of gameplay timing.
purpose.stance_sink_units: Lower the body slightly to give the joint solver bend while feet remain planted.
purpose.stance_fraction: Fraction of each cycle spent on the ground; opposite tripods overlap in stance.
purpose.step_units: Forward/back foot sweep in source space; actual source cycle distance is step / stance_fraction.
purpose.foot_lift_units: Clearance of the three swinging feet above a flat floor.
purpose.breath_units: Small idle body movement while the six feet remain planted.
purpose.head_windup_radians: Small head lift and mandibular brace on the native windup fraction.
purpose.head_followthrough_radians: Short downward bite follow-through after the native strike event.
purpose.mandible_open_radians: Open the supported mandibles during the existing melee warning.
purpose.mandible_close_radians: Small closing follow-through; no new contact or damage.
purpose.antenna_sweep_radians: Subtle supported sensory movement during idle and travel.
purpose.durations: Authored sample ranges only; native Enemy and CreatureMotion own timing.
purpose.uniform_metres_per_source_unit: Uniform animal size before family/elite scale; swarm has no 0.76 reduction.
purpose.cosmetic_stride_metres: One metre per cycle gives five quick tripod cycles per second at native 5m/s; deliberate sliding, not a movement change.
purpose.cull_margin_source_units: Keeps moving leg tips inside the visual culling envelope.
purpose.joints: Measured asymmetric Blender Z-up, +Y-forward source landmarks.
